chunks: And with the same chain of narration, the Messenger of God, peace and blessings upon him and his family, said:

On the Day of Resurrection, the feet of a servant will not move from before God, the Mighty and Glorious, until He asks him about four things: your life - how you spent it; your wealth - where you earned it and where you spent it; and about our love, the Ahl al-Bayt. A man from the people said: And what is the sign of your love, O Messenger of God? He said: The love of this one - and he placed his hand on the head of Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.

key_terms.حبنا أهل البيت: Our love, the Ahl al-Bayt - love for the Prophet's household
key_terms.خصال: Qualities or matters one is questioned about
key_terms.محبة هذا: Love of this one - referring to Ali ibn Abi Talib

ai.seo_question: What are the four questions asked on the Day of Judgment according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWA) states that on the Day of Judgment, every servant will be questioned about four matters: how they spent their life, how they earned and spent their wealth, and their love for the Ahl al-Bayt. When asked what constitutes the sign of this love, the Prophet placed his hand on Ali's head, indicating that love for Ali is the mark of loving the Prophet's household.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. And with the same chain of narration, the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

On the day of Resurrection, the feet of a slave will not move away from Allah, Most High, unless He has asked him four things: "How did you while away your life? How did you earn your wealth? And where did you spend it? And He will ask him about our love, the Ahlul Bayt." A person present asked: "And what is the sign of your love, O messenger of Allah?" He said: "To love him," and then he placed his hand on the head of ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him.
